ruleDefinitions.name: DotNet CLR DLL Loaded By Scripting Applications
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects .NET CLR DLLs being loaded by scripting applications such as wscript or cscript. This could be an indication of potential suspicious execution. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msxsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\clr\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\mscoree\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\mscorlib\\\.dll$")))
